work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCLXXVI to Archbishop Ferdinando Minucci of Florence deplores the renewed Tuscan law subjecting bishops’ printed acts to lay censorship, renews Pius VII’s guidance that bishops may print while remaining merely passive toward the government’s restraints, and asks him to communicate the letter to the Tuscan Ordinaries; address LF46806–46808, intitulation, greeting, body, blessing and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF46811–46811; the source dating clause at LF46961–46964 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum die vigesima septima aprilis anno millesimo octingentesimo guadragesimo quarto, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo quarto. Isolated OCR marks fused into body lines remain literal and are not removed or corrected: LF46873 “-”. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
